description.zh: 部署集ID列表。取值可以由多个部署集ID组成一个JSON数组，格式为`["ds-xxxxxxxxx", "ds-yyyyyyyyy", … "ds-zzzzzzzzz"]`。最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of the deployment sets. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 deployment set IDs. Sample format: `["ds-xxxxxxxxx", "ds-yyyyyyyyy", … "ds-zzzzzzzzz"]`.

description.zh: 部署集名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the deployment set. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
部署集列表的页码。

起始值为1。

默认值为1。
description.en:
The page number.

Starts at 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值为50。

默认值为10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 部署集所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region where the deployment set is located. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
部署策略。取值范围：

- Availability：高可用策略。
- AvailabilityGroup：部署集组高可用策略。
- LowLatency：网络低时延策略。
description.en:
The deployment strategy. Valid values:

- Availability: high availability strategy.

- AvailabilityGroup: high availability group strategy.

- LowLatency: low-latency strategy.

description.zh:
部署类型。取值范围：
- host：物理机
- sw：交换机
- rack：机架

默认值：host。
description.en:
The deployment type. Valid values:

- host: Ensures that the instances in the deployment set are deployed on different hosts.

- sw: Ensures that the instances in the deployment set are deployed on different switches.

- rack: Ensures that the instances in the deployment set are deployed on different racks.

Default value: host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-deployment-sets --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --deployment-set-ids 'ds-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000_,_ds-bp67acfmxazb4pi0000_,_…_ds-bp67acfmxazb4pj0000' --network-type example-string --strategy Availability --deployment-set-name testDeploymentSetName --granularity example-string --domain example-string --type host --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeDeploymentSets --region cn-hangzhou --Type host --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --DeploymentSetIds 'ds-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000_,_ds-bp67acfmxazb4pi0000_,_…_ds-bp67acfmxazb4pj0000' --NetworkType 'example-string' --Strategy Availability --DeploymentSetName testDeploymentSetName --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Granularity 'example-string' --Domain 'example-string'
